_metadata.description: Citations the first full-coverage run (2026-09-26) flagged: 'mismatch' means the live PubMed record shares no identity word with its entry (a heuristic; many are wrong papers, some are naming misses), 'not_found' means the PMID does not resolve. The release gate fails on any not_found and on any mismatch NOT listed here, so a new bad citation cannot hide in this backlog. Fix entries one at a time via /data-fix and delete each from this list in the same commit (register Q22). The 10 medication_depletions items are needs_revision records the app suppresses.
_metadata.source_run: verify_all_citations_content.py --report (after e349a2b7: every citation in scripts/data read)
_metadata.not_found_recheck: esummary 2026-09-26: 28200047 (ginger_extract) and 22647284 (slendesta) do not exist in PubMed. 29144655 (lutemax_2020) is a PubmedBookArticle, an IQWiG dulaglutide dossier, read as not found until 05c3e5ad; listed as mismatch. Fixed: ginger_extract now cites PMID 25848702 (2026-09-26). Fixed: slendesta now cites PMID 28485429 (2026-09-26).
